title: CodeFlow Candidate (Harvest -> Slice contract)
$comment: Ticket 02. Stage 1 Domain Harvest output; input to Stage 2 Structural Slice.
description: One harvestable flow candidate discovered from a domain marker. Normative rules carried by this contract: trigger class enum is closed; intentSignals are REQUIRED so an agent can natural-language-match candidates without re-reading code; scoring fields feed the automatic priority order (marker specificity x fan-in x boundary reachability); dedup fields encode root-equivalence merging and tie-breaking (marker specificity > declaration order) per R11; state-mutation points are attributed as steps inside a root flow, never independent roots.

candidateId.description: 'cand-' + first 16 lowercase-hex chars of sha256(canonicalEntrySymbolPath UTF-8 bytes); same collision suffix rule as flowId.

markerKind.description: Concrete marker matched by the framework profile pack (e.g. profiles/riverpod.yaml). New kinds arrive with new profile packs and require a schema minor version bump, never silent extension.

className.description: Declaring class/type name of the entry symbol.

derivedName.description: Deterministic identifier-rule transform (e.g. 'submitOrder' -> '주문을 제출한다'). Not LLM output.

docLine.description: First doc-comment line on the symbol if present, else null.

packageName.description: Dart package name the entry file resolves to.

intentSignals.description: REQUIRED agent-facing signal bundle for natural-language candidate matching (design §8.1).

rootEquivalenceKey.description: Key under which candidates converging on the same business-flow root are deduplicated (R11): equal keys => same flow root; the winner is decided by tieBreakRank and losers set dedupedInto.

dedupedInto.description: candidateId of the surviving representative when this candidate lost root-equivalence dedup; null when this candidate is itself the root.

tieBreakRank.description: Rank within one rootEquivalenceKey group after applying tie-breakers (marker specificity > declaration order). Lower wins.

manifestOverride.description: Override from codeflow.flows.yaml manifest; manifest always wins over automatic scoring.
